name: The thriller in four parts
hint: A threat, a chase, a twist and a reckoning against the clock, with the stakes rising in every part.

parts.title: The threat
chapters: Ordinary life
Show the main character, what they are good at and what they stand to lose, with a shadow of danger on page one.
The first sign
Something is wrong, and the main character is the only one who sees it. The inciting moment.
No one believes them
The attempt to get help fails, so they have to act on their own.
No way back
A choice or an event locks them into the chase. Going home is no longer possible.

parts.title: The chase
chapters: The trail
The main character takes the initiative and gets closer, but every answer raises a new question.
The opponent strikes back
The villain answers with a move that shows how dangerous they are and how far they will go.
The clock starts
A concrete deadline makes everything urgent, and the reader knows exactly when it will be too late.
The midpoint
The main character goes from hunted to hunter, or wins a victory that turns out to be false.

parts.title: The twist
chapters: Everything was wrong
A planted truth turns what the reader believed upside down, and the plan collapses.
It gets personal
The threat turns on what the main character loves most, and the stakes peak.
Alone
The ally betrays them or falls. The darkest point, with the least time left.
The last plan
The main character understands something about themselves or the villain and decides to strike.

parts.title: The reckoning
chapters: Against the clock
The plan goes into action and goes wrong. Everything is decided in little time, in short scenes.
Face to face
The main character confronts the villain and wins through their own skill and choice, not luck.
After
Briefly: what has changed, what it cost, and whether the threat is truly over.
